text_fidelity_a: Fitbit Zip Wireless Activity Tracker, Magenta This is the third Fitbit device I have had and they all have gone bad in a very short time.  In the past I had a Fitbit One and a Fitbit Flex.  I have had this one just a few days over a month and have had a multitude of problems.  The first was that the display went blank.  When I contacted Fitbit customer service they suggested that I take the battery out and reinstall it.  That did the trick and I once again had a display on the front, but how often should I have to do that?  Then the tip of the silicone case fell off, exposing the sharp metal clip.  Once again I contacted customer service and they agreed to send me a new case.  Today it is not working again.  This time the Zip says on the display that I have 10,322 steps, my iPhone app says I have 7,099 steps, and the Fitbit website tells me I have 8,618.  Not very accurate to say the least.  My Zip has an icon of a battery with a line through it blinking on the front.  I have no idea what that means.  When I try to sync with my phone app it shows a full battery.  Since I have used it only month it certainly should be full.  I wish I had not been traveling when so much of this happened or I would have sent it back.  Just wasted money in my opinion.  I would not recommend any Fitbit product to anyone.
text_fidelity_b: Fitbit Zip Wireless Activity Tracker, Magenta

text_fidelity_a:
Coleman 3000000455 Latern Pump Kit This kit is dog easy the second time around. Unfortunately the second time may be decades away. Hopefully.
I faithfully disassembled my pump from my 45 year old Coleman stove (Bless em! Most of the guys who built the thing are no doubt long gone to their various rewards)....but anyway, I elected to rebuild the old pump which was a mistake. The new cup is designed for the new rod. It does not work on the old one.
On the old rod there is a metal stop that holds the cup. The new cup is different. If you have a super oldie like mine you will take the metal retaining clip off the new pump with needle nosed pliars. Wiggle under the metal clip and wiggle it off. Slide everything off. Put the round metal ring thingy which holds it to the tank on, then the spring. Follow with the NYLON stop ring. Then put the cup on top of that followed by the new round metal spring clip, or the old. That much is the same.
Put it back in the unit. I started it at the bottom and chased it around with my thumbnail until all of the cup was in....then shoved it home. Some people might have elected to put a bit of grease on the cup before installation but I chose the venerable 3-1 oil before...and after.
After all that it worked like a charm. It's quick and simple if you do it right.
text_fidelity_b: Coleman 3000000455 Latern Pump Kit

WAAO Hand Grip Strengthener Workout, Hand Exerciser, Strength Trainer, Adjustable Resistance Range 22-88 Lbs, Non-Slip Gripper, Great for Athletes Pianists Kids & Hand Rehabilitation Exercising I've never had great hand strength and thought this device might help. The bright blue handles are easy to hold. There is a black knob which turns to adjust the resistance. Resistance ranges from 22-88 lbs. Unfortunately there are no directions or training suggestions included. I started using the lowest setting. To start, hold the strengthener in the palm of your hand. Wrap your fingertips around one of the handles so that it rests in the middle of your fingers. Your fingertips should cover it while the other handle is positioned against the lower part of your palm.Squeeze the handles together while you exhale and inhale as you slowly return to the starting position. I try to do a set of six to eight repetitions. try to keep the rest of your body still while performing. I stay at a resistance until it becomes easy and then I move up. My mother uses this device also. Since having a stroke, her hands are very weak and her grip strength is minimal. She started with one to two repetitions and is slowly gaining strength and endurance. It certainly performs well, seems to be well made and should last.

I received a complimentary/discounted product for testing and review.
text_fidelity_b: WAAO Hand Grip Strengthener Workout, Hand Exerciser, Strength Trainer, Adjustable Resistance Range 22-88 Lbs, Non-Slip Gripper, Great for Athletes Pianists Kids & Hand Rehabilitation Exercising

Crampons Ice Cleats Traction Snow Grips with 19 Spikes for Women Men Kids Boots Shoes Safe Protect Lightweight Crampons, Hiking, Walking, Climbing, Jogging Mountaineering on Ice and Snow I live in the land of black ice on the road at any time in the winter and frequently right before heading home or on the way to work.

I've lived in MN where I never needed them for ambulatory traction for whatever reason and I just assumed that I knew what black ice roads meant. I was wrong. I know what snowy, packed roads are. I know what lake driving on ice is. Black ice is wholly different.

You discover black ice in the Rockies driving up mountain roads, right in the few miles where the fog separates the wet road from the snow. The car can not be controlled without chains and you’ve likely brought chains as you drive in the mountains in winter. You can't stand up on the road without crampons. Then you might discover an ice storm in TX or OK where black ice is worse. You likely won’t have chains. The car will slide uncontrollably off the crown of the road. Again, crampons are the only solution to peel the fender from the fence post you just caught sliding off the road at 2 mph.

These crampons go on fast and are more than just small foot chains and less than glacier wear. Perfect for the trucks emergency prep.

text_fidelity_a:
Levi's Men's 2-Horse Graphic Tee I decided to rate this 4-stars DESPITE getting the wrong “version” which would’ve dropped it to 3-stars.

I had requested the “(New) Dress Blues” version (red print on dark blue); I ended up with the “: (New) Mineral Black” (white print on black). And, honestly? I LOVE the version I got instead. Definitely more clear and bold.

Definitely comfy too.

So, if I like the print style and the comfort, why 4-stars?

THE FIT.

I’m a plus-size girl, so I tend to wear bigger clothes. And, for a gal that wears a 3XL? This fits my frame 100% perfectly. No slouch, no overages, nothing “boxy”.

Why is that a problem?

This is a MEN’s PLUS-SIZE. It shouldn’t FIT like a LADIES 3XL. I know because when I’d buy “mens” (or unisex) t-shirts at souvenir places or the racetracks – the 3XL versions would always be BIGGER than the women’s versions. Also, the “cut” would be more “boxy” for the lack of a better term.

This had a more “ladies” cut/style to it.

It is also shorter than the usual MENS style. This fit rather “short” for a guy, but perfect on my LADIES’ body – almost like it was for a girl.

It had ALL the LEVIs tags – the country/care tag, price tag, side tag, and even the “screen print” neck tag. So, definitely a genuine article.

Perhaps it was a “unicorn” (rare) shirt or how the t-shirt are being designed.

If you’re a BIGGER guy and need a long, boxy, big tee – I wouldn’t recommend this.

If you’re a bigger gal that wants a well-fit, slim, and shorter tee – I’d definitely get this.
text_fidelity_b: Levi's Men's 2-Horse Graphic Tee

text_fidelity_a:
Fuliuyu Long Range Green Presentation Pointer High Power Flashlight with USB Cable, Rechargeable Adjustable Focus for Night Astronomy Outdoor Work Pet Interaction Conference While not an indictment of the quality of the product, this laser is listed as being good for interacting with pets. However, this laser is powerful enough to do some serious eye damage! It's powerful enough to pop a dark colored balloon if held in place for a moment. In fact, it's powerful enough that if I point it at the back of my hand and hold it in place for a few seconds, it begins to sting! That's more than bright enough to permanently damage your pet's eyes, especially if you're pointing it towards them in order to get them to chase after it. Lasers like these are not currently well regulated on this site, so you should not assume that they are safe. I'd advise wearing proper laser safety goggles when using this laser, never point it towards a person, and please don't use it to play with your pets!

And now that I've got that diatribe out of the way, the product itself seems fairly well made, and at a decent price. It has a nice protector ring that covers the "on" button to help prevent accidental discharge. This helps with safety, as well as keeping your battery from draining due to accidental use. The beam is pretty well focused, and I don't see much diffusion even 50-100 feet out. On a cloudy day, the laser point (not the beam, but the spot where it is pointed) is clearly visible at 100-200 feet of distance. At night, the beam itself is clearly visible in the atmosphere.
text_fidelity_b: Fuliuyu Long Range Green Presentation Pointer High Power Flashlight with USB Cable, Rechargeable Adjustable Focus for Night Astronomy Outdoor Work Pet Interaction Conference

text_fidelity_a:
EBAT LED Lantern Recharged by solar panel+USB Cable for Travel, Picnic, Hiking, Yellow [[VIDEOID:7cace53d54dd11d9ca86d52ec20f0527]] If you ever go camping or if you live in an area where there are frequent power outages you understand the need for a good lantern. I have worked with several lanterns and while I have used some that are a little brighter or a little more compact, this one is a decent one that has some good features. Besides having a couple of operation modes, it is chargeable via solar energy.

This is a reasonably bright lantern but it is not blindingly bright like some others I have seen. This is a trade-off in my book. If you are expecting something that is bright enough to light a small camp area and allow you to read by it, this is a decent lamp. If you want something to light a 20'x20' room it is not strong enough to provide color recognition through the whole room.

This lantern has a rechargeable battery that can be removed and plugged in to the provided power adapter for recharging. It can also be opened up to expose a pair of solar panels so it can be charged up via solar power. There is something very important to understand about solar charging, though – using the solar panels to charge this lantern takes a lot longer than if plugging the pack in. I have not tried to completely charge the lantern via solar power but in my experience solar charging takes roughly 4 to 5 times longer. That said, if you do not have the option to plug in, the solar panel is a superb option.

This lantern seems to be solidly made and resistant to easy breakage. So, I believe it would survive a drop from a short distance, though I would hesitate to test this theory. The hook loop on top is plastic but it seems sturdy enough to handle frequent use and abuse.

This lantern has two operation modes. It has two brightnesses – dim and bright. The dim light is enough to light a hallway when carrying this lantern though it is not going to work for tromping through the woods. The bright setting is not actually all that bright but it is enough to see through a large room and make out everything in it, though it does not cast enough light to see colors clearly at more than 10' or so.

Overall, this is a decent little lantern. It seems to be made well and it can be charged by either a power adapter or solar power. Just keep in mind that it is not going to charge quickly if using the solar cells to charge it up.

Disclaimer: I was provided a sample of this product in exchange for a fair, honest and thorough review. Even though I received this product at no cost I have rated and reviewed this product without bias, based solely on my experience with it.
text_fidelity_b: EBAT LED Lantern Recharged by solar panel+USB Cable for Travel, Picnic, Hiking, Yellow

text_fidelity_a:
Zippo Hand Warmer 2011 I have tried Penguin before Zippo.
I was pretty disappointed by Penguin, so I had high hope for Zippo. It's a cheap knock off of Hakukin(Peacock) hand warmer just like Penguin.
Zippo hand warmer is made in Taiwan, where as Hakukin(Peacock) is made in Japan by Hakukin for 80 years.
First imperssion of Zippo, looks just as cheap as Penguin(I think it was labeled as made in China). The burner looks different from Penguin or Hakukin.
I believe some of the positive reviews in here are real but I'm guessing there is a big quality control problem. Even if it starts working good, I don't think it'll keep working for a long time. Not too many follow up updates about positive experiences have been posted.
My first try, it got warmed up a little then kept the luke warmth for a while. It died and became cold before long. Second try, no luck.
Next, I'll try drop of fuel on the burner method which worked for Penguin a couple of times. It's the last resort which will ruin the burner something you shouldn't be doing.
I have to wonder why Hakukin is not sold in US? It seems to be available in England, why not in US? I would pay twice the price I paid for Zippo and still be happy with Hakukin.

*Update*(12-20-11)
There seems to be some organized effort by either the maker or the stores that sell them to rate down the negative reviews. Just look at the number of "Helpful".
Shameless.

*Update* (1-27-14)
Hakkin (Peacock) works!!!
I got it from -Bay through a vendor in Korea, even though it is starting to appear in amazon but the price is higher compare to -Bay. I was fully prepared to get disappointed because of the past experience with other products. It lighted the first time I tried, I couldn't believe it!! The catalyst(burner) even glows red in the dark that was something I wasn't expecting. I was like "Aha! This is how it supposed to work!!"
You pay more for the real thing but it's worth it. If it doesn't work, it's worthless no matter how much you save.
Get Hakkin, you won't regret it.
You will regret with Zippo.
text_fidelity_b: Zippo Hand Warmer 2011

text_fidelity_a:
Greenlight Planet Sun King Pro an Portable Solar Lantern Plus USB Charger This is my 3rd Sun King Solar Light, but my 1st Sun King Pro2 model and I'm happy to report that the SK2 model does everything the original did but also includes the very useful ability to charge cell phones or mobile devices such as tablets or laptops as well (and fairly quickly too).

The Sun King Solar Lights are used extensively in remote areas of Africa or India where residents lack access to electricity, but their usefulness is not limited to those purposes at all because they are extremely handy to have on hand here in America as well for applications like camping trips, night lights, to save money by using them instead of electric lights, or for emergency lighting in case the power is out!

Offering 3 settings, the lowest setting is bright enough to act to light hallways well enough to act as a nightlight & provide safe navigation of rooms in case of power outage (and can last for 36 hrs on a full charge). The other settings are brighter and you can position the lamp on its stand to act as a reading light or point it upwards instead towards the ceiling to light up an entire room. In fact, the light is so versatile that you could also remove it from the stand and hang it from a wall or ceiling hook inside the house or in a tent if so desired and it provides good lighting all night when charged.

The solar panel is small enough to be conveniently moved around effortlessly, comes with a long enough power cord to reach the lamp for charging, has an easy to read display that lets you know if you're getting enough sun strength in the current position or whether you need to adjust the angle more and also lets you know whether the light is fully charged or not.

15 times brighter than a typical kerosene lamp (and totally safe to use), with convenient dual USB ports, Sun King Pro 2 can charge a phone while simultaneously powering an additional appliance or a second phone plus it has a five-year battery lifetime. It's light enough to charge & position effortlessly and yet extremely well made and durable.

I not only recommend the Sun King Pro2 Solar Lights to my friends - I intend to buy more for my home as well!

text_fidelity_a:
SYLVANIA RX2 OSRAM LED Bicycle Taillight This is a 2.4 lux/4 lumen rain proof and splash proof bicycle taillight which takes 2 AAA batteries (not included). These batteries should provide 36 hours of illumination according to the package.

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this light. First, it's practically impossible to remove the cover to insert the batteries. There's a notch at the bottom of the light that is used to open the compartment. I had to use a letter opener to pry it open while squeezing the top a bit. The force that had to be used damaged the plastic around the notch but did not affect the light's functionality. There are four plastic prongs that hold the top reflector onto the base and I can see these prongs breaking when opening or closing the compartment to replace the batteries.

I have a Trek bike and it was difficult to position on my bike because the height of the light got in the way of the reflector that was already there. However, the mounting bracket is a typical bracket that clenches itself around the bike frame. The light clips onto the fastener and can be removed and used elsewhere, such as clipping onto a backpack or hat for use when walking.

The light turns on via a button on the back. Only the top "bulging" part lights up as the bottom acts as a reflector.

Because of the difficulty of opening this light and chance for breakage during battery replacement, I personally cannot recommend this. This is not a light I would purchase after having tried it.
text_fidelity_b: SYLVANIA RX2 OSRAM LED Bicycle Taillight

There are bag coolers that have thicker walls than this, but this should be fine when transporting groceries home in the summer. I would not fill the entire product with cans and ice, like the marketing photo shows, since this would likely stress the seams too much. Use a solid plastic cooler for heavy items like that.

I would prefer if coolers had a plastic shelf on the bottom to keep the items away from melted water or spilled liquids that collect on the bottom. Most coolers do not have this feature. I have been using plastic liners that I took from my Tupperware produce storage containers.

The current price is $39. I see less expensive coolers that are probably just as good.

Features that some other coolers have are wheels for transporting heavy items, and some can be plugged into a car outlet or wall outlet for refrigeration. Other coolers collapse more when put into storage. This one is not designed to be collapsed, although it can be smooshed into a smaller shape when not in use. Good coolers can last many years, so you might want to invest in a high-quality one.

text_fidelity_a:
KEEPTO Exercise Resistance Band Set with Handles,5 Fitness Workout Bands for Women at Home Gym We have a large array of options for working out - to loose/keep off weight and build and maintain muscle. But among the options we wanted something that we could travel with as well as give us a variety of options at home. Boredom can kill a workout routine.

I specifically chose this set for 1. the variety and choices of weights, 2. The options for use with/without a door, 3. The look of the hand and ankle straps and handles, 4. The look of the ends of the bands - their connector including the carabiner connectors.

1. The variety of weights/resistance allows one to go up to 120 lbs. We are not there, but we have the option. Changing the bands out can give a range of weight options and this was a good one compared to others. It also lets one adjust what they are doing - legs, arms.

2. The options for use with or without a door means one can anchor the bands under one’s foot or in a door. We have a TRX set we use with a door, but this gives us another option - we would be more likely to travel with this set now so if unable to use in a door on a trip we would still have the ability to use our feet. That said, there is something “better” to a TRX version. It feels stronger - but it is slightly heavier, while this set is more complicated with all the items included.

3. The hand and ankle straps appeared average overall, but better than some other sets we were looking at. The handles are a bit “rough,” but not uncomfortable. I have worked them with and without gloves and both are fine. The ankle straps are average in feel, but better than some I’ve experienced. Overall both are just fine.

4. I was mostly concerned that they would have longevity. I looked at how the bands connected to the handles, how they were topped off to keep their own ends secure. Compared to others - via pictures - these appeared to have good, solid endings, and that the make up of how they connect to the handles was a good method. I know the carabiners are the weakest link and I took that into consideration. I think they are pretty solid - based on pictures and how they feel - but I am prepared should they fail - we would be able to change them out for others if needed.

Overall we are happy with this choice. The set is what it appears to be, but compared to many others - and I looked at more than 20 sets - this one had everything we wanted, feels as though it has the longevity and strength we wanted and expect, and will give us another successful workout option.

Happy to recommend.
text_fidelity_b: KEEPTO Exercise Resistance Band Set with Handles,5 Fitness Workout Bands for Women at Home Gym

They are more like VR or AT googles though because the image is on a screen inside the googles and enhanced through software so it leaves a slight lag. My biggest issue with these are the placement of the buttons and I don't believe it would hold up to poor weather conditions. Other then that it has a good picture and functions as advertised. I am curious to see how long they hold up though. I will update this review as needed based their performance in the future. text_fidelity_a:
Franklin Sports Shoot N Score Hockey Shootout Game Great idea, and it is fun! But... Franklin cut so many corners making this, it ruins it.
Problems with the game:
* Shoddy build quality, the parts do not stay together as they should. Annoying to build, and rebuild during play
* No volume control! This thing is loud! but its an indoor toy. A volume control would have made it much more enjoyable.
* No storage for the balls - a little drawer or a cover for the channel that contains them during play would have helped hugely
* Only 30 second games. Why not a range? add one minute, three minutes and five minutes!
* Poor design allows the ball to often get trapped behind the goalie
* Poor design allows the ball to easily get trapped behind the player (and with only 30 seconds to play, these two issues can be real game spoilers)
* Poor design allows you to quite often "score" even though the ball did not score, it bounced of the goalie and jumped the side rail/

If you can put up with all of that, it is a lit of fun. It is such a shame that they did not put just a little more work into it to make it a great game.
text_fidelity_b: Franklin Sports Shoot N Score Hockey Shootout Game

I like tea bottles over cups as I am a lot less likely to spill tea in a bottle versus a cup, so I have several that I keep on my desk. I was interested in trying this tea bottle, and it has worked out well for me so far.

One thing that is different about this bottle is the screen. The screen is located at the bottom of the bottle, not at the top. It also is bigger than most, being slightly larger than a 35mm film tube. The holes in it are small enough to keep larger particles form getting the tea but they are not small enough to keep something like fine tea leaves (or regular ground coffee) out.

The bottle is borosilicate glass and is single layer. So, to compensate for the lack of insulation the bottle comes with a sleeve that keeps you from burning your hand and also helps to keep the contents of the bottle hot (or cold, as appropriate). The sleeve is easy to put on and take off.

The bottle comes with two bottle brushes and a handle for those brushes. The brushes are simply foam heads on a plastic handle but they are sufficient for properly cleaning out the bottle.

So far this bottle has worked out well for me. I am happy with it.

Disclosure: I was provided a sample of this product in exchange for a fair, honest and thorough review. Even though I received this product at minimal or no cost I have rated and reviewed this product without bias, based solely on my experience with it.

Frankford Arsenal Quick-N-EZ 110V Case Tumbler Kit with Sifter for Brass Cartridge Cleaning and Polishing for Reloading [[VIDEOID:4d97ce6c49de579dc9b8d7678abf3b9f]] Maybe it is a little early for this review since I got this yesterday but I am very impressed and this has been run about 16 hours out of the last 20. I set it on a smart plug timer so it could even do a late night batch without running all night. I used to do ultrasonic cleaning but I hated the drying process and the less pleasing lack of that brassy shine you get with tumbling.
A couple pieces of advice....I saw reviewers mentioning the center bolt dinging up brass, the fix is SUPER easy. A simple drinking straw to cover the threads. I even found a blue one that matches the tumbler.
Second piece of advice, don't be dumb like me. I had a handful of .223 that I decided to add to the .40 cal I was tumbling. .223 fits in the .40 cal so many of the .223 had unpolished bases. Just remember 9 mm fits in .40 and .40 fits in .45. so pay attention if you mix brass. Make sure it can't fit inside the other type.
text_fidelity_b: Frankford Arsenal Quick-N-EZ 110V Case Tumbler Kit with Sifter for Brass Cartridge Cleaning and Polishing for Reloading

Slant Board - Multi-Level Slanted Calf Stretcher - Adjustable Wooden Incline Exercise Platform - Perfect for Tight Muscles, Plantar Fasciitis, Achilles Tendonitis - Supports Up to 350lbs weight I have been using the thick ream of printer paper to do regular bunion exercises in my doorway for some time now. The problem is that when I need to use the paper, there goes my lift. Books don't tend to work as well for me, but then I saw this. YAY! It is PERFECT!

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This amazing little unit is fabulous. It comes all folded up and has a heavy duty carry case in it. There are pieces that need to be put on it. I will break it down for you.

HEEL REST
There are two heel rests that go on the bottom of the foot board if you want to use them. They have four pegs which tightly fit into the wood holes drilled for them. There are two screw holes to keep them in place, along with screws that come with the unit. YOU WILL HAVE TO USE A POWER DRILL TO PUT THE SCREWS IN. IT IS NOT PRE-DRILLED INTO THE WOOD BASE PART.

FOOT REST
The place where you put your feet has like heavy duty sandpaper on it. That will hold feet in place either with shoes or bare feet. I have no problems using this with bare feet which I prefer.

EYE PINS
There are several levels that you can put the incline at, and two eye pins that you simply slip through the holes once they are set at level to keep it in place.

LEVELS
The levels of this are PERFECT for me. They are great to put centered in a doorway. Using the sides of the door frame, I tilt backwards and then slowly pull myself upright parallel with the door frame and hold in place for about 30 seconds if I can and then slowly let myself go backwards again.

Several repetitions at level 2 and I am ready to move up again.

DOES IT HELP?
This is fabulous. It is perfect. It helps and does exactly what I want it to. My calves are stretched and it does help keep bunions reduced with consistent use.

DOES IT HOLD WEIGHT?
We have a variety of weights in the family up to 300 lbs. Everyone felt very sturdy on this, although the largest one does not like calf stretches, so they won't be using it. Heck, NO ONE will be using this because I want it to stay in one piece. HAHA Guess I will have to hide this too.

CASE
The case makes it much easier to use this board. It has handles, and zips shut. The fabric is very sturdy and will hold up for quite a while. I love it because I can put it away and bring it out easier due to the handles.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I am VERY happy with this board. It has helped me resume my bunion stretches so I don't have to depend on reams of printer paper anymore. I can pull this out anytime I want and be able to use this in my doorway, barefoot or with shoes on.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is just what I wanted. It is perfect for me. HIGHLY recommended.
text_fidelity_b: Slant Board - Multi-Level Slanted Calf Stretcher - Adjustable Wooden Incline Exercise Platform - Perfect for Tight Muscles, Plantar Fasciitis, Achilles Tendonitis - Supports Up to 350lbs weight

text_fidelity_a:
Planet Bike Grunge Board downtube bike fender I've got a bicycle without any mounting holes for fenders. It also doesn't have enough clearance between the forks/brakes and tires to jerry-rig a fender. However, I hate not riding my bike because of light rain or a few puddles.

The Grunge Board was the best option that I could find at a reasonable price. It straps onto the downtube with a couple of rubber straps. I've got an 80s racing bike with tight geometry, and the dimensions of the board are small enough to clear the crankarms and the front wheel during turns. But just so (orientation makes a difference).

I've ridden through some big puddles and it seems to do a fairly good job of keeping my pant legs from getting soaked. I still put some scotch tape over the holes/slits around the bottom bracket to keep the gunk from getting in. The board is light enough that I leave it on all the time, even when it's not raining...just in case there is an unexpected puddle.

I have to take off a star because I think the mounting band should have been designed better. First, it hard to push the rubber bands through the narrow slots once they wrap around the downtube. The bands have slits in them that attach to nubs on the underside of the board. The nubs are not large enough to hold the bands in place perfectly securely. They seem to usually work, but the bands come off occasionally. If you have a small diameter downtube (as in most pre-90s, bikes), there are also a couple inches of extra rubber band that just flop around. It shouldn't be too hard for Planet Bike to redesign this retention mechanism, but it's also hard to complain for ~$10.

You can use a couple of cable ties instead of the rubber bands and they'd probably do a better job. You could also use a large soda bottle cut to size and get the same effect, though arguably a bit uglier.
text_fidelity_b: Planet Bike Grunge Board downtube bike fender

text_fidelity_a:
Litume All Season Sleeping Bag Liner Adds Up to 27F, Lightweight Mummy Sleeping Sack for Backpacking, Camping, Traveling with Drawstring Hood and Stuff Sack I love, I repeat LOVE, this sleeping bag liner.

We are restless from Covid and itching for a little adventure while still quarantining. Set up a tent in the backyard, but needed all kinds of supplies to ensure our comfort, including more bags, mattresses, and a liner for me as I run very cold and we intend to camp til the first snow, at least.

But back to the liner. I’d bought this brand, and another cheaper, thinner liner. While the thinner liner did help my husband, it was noticeably thinner and cheaper in quality. But this liner really overheated me. This isn’t a bad thing (if only because I didn’t die) because I had a zero degree bag in 40 degree weather. Still, I was getting chilly feet and calves which convinced me it must be getting colder so I stood up, climbed feet first in the liner, then jumped in the air repeatedly as I pulled up the long liner til my feet hit bottom, making sure the hood was positioned in the back. The jumping must’ve looked ridiculous but it only took seconds so I recommend that rather than trying to slide yourself in while it’s in the bag. Anyway, now back to my night.

It felt great, the density of the fleece. The outside of the material isn’t slippery but wasn’t much of a problem for turning over in my bag. Just take care to twist the bag where/ if needed after you’ve turned in your bag. I move very little in my bag though. To make a long story short, it provided a thick, comforting layer although I woke up early feeling like my legs and feet were about to ignite due to immense heat. It had gotten quite warm in the tent already by morning and I realized I hadn’t needed the liner for my cold self that night (although I overheated, I never woke up due to taking a med for insomnia that night). So, the next night I kept the liner folded underneath me in my bag. Even that got too warm. I’m telling you it has a real WARMING EFFECT as my body touched it, it seemed to warm up so much that it felt like an electric blanket at times. Night 3 was perfect without the liner. Live and learn, right?

Bottom line: it adds substantial heat to your bag. I have no idea how many degrees, but I’d guess around 20? It is well made, soft, substantial, and the fact that it doesn’t have a zipper to leak heat is a plus for my purpose which is staying warm in colder temperatures. Although it was uncomfortable almost spontaneously combusting inside my warm bag, I feel confident in this bag to keep me substantially warmer when the time comes. I will report back if the liner falls short of my expectations. So far, it has exceeded them!

And oh, I bought another as we are a family of campers. Likely I’ll be buying a couple more before spring!
text_fidelity_b: Litume All Season Sleeping Bag Liner Adds Up to 27F, Lightweight Mummy Sleeping Sack for Backpacking, Camping, Traveling with Drawstring Hood and Stuff Sack

Surprisingly, this has ample stretch and can fit the largest of heads- Yet take note, this isn’t the slouchy style trend.. NO!! (Note: as with any beanie.. avoid heat drying if, concern for shrinking. I tend to avoid this at first and use dryer when beanie becomes worn in and seems to become too loose- boom! Doing this, Beanie will be back in action..!!) **Also, with the folded edge this is adjustable! One can adjust hat size by less/more of the fold- A total bonus in getting the right fit!

As you can see I’m a total fan and true believer Adidas makes the best beanie by far 100%- at a slightly higher price point it is worth it.. As, this will last you seasons to come! With a child who wears a beanie as often as he wears underwear, I’ve tried every version on the market and hands-down this is our “go to” every time! My oldest daughter saw it as soon as it arrived however and said it would be perfect for her to carry her stuff to the gym and dance class, so that's what this one's going to be used for.

Made of a soft, waterproof nylon material, this sling bag has plenty of roomy pockets and pouches built into it, so it can hold a lot! There's a deep open pouch in the very front that can hold a water bottle, flashlight sunglasses, sports towel, or cell phone, and directly behind that is a deep zippered compartment with two sleeves along the back for tanning lotion or whatever. Behind that zippered pocket is yet another full sized zippered pocket to hold even more gear, and this one has padding along the back side of it to cushion your body from the gear you're carrying. The back side of the pack is made of a non-abrasive nylon mesh material which feels soft rather than scratchy and is breathable so the material doesn't make you perspire when wearing the pack. It has a well padded adjustable shoulder strap that that's wide enough to bear the weight of the pack without digging into your shoulder, and there's even a narrow pocket with a pull closure built into the strap so you could put something small like an MP3 player & earbuds in it.

text_fidelity_a: THKFISH Fishing Spooler, 1Pcs Fishing Line Spooler with Suction Cup Fishing Reel Spooler Fishing Tackle Spooler System I paid very little, much less than current price being charged. I purchased this Fishing Line Spooler System from thkfish, as an add on to my collection of line spoolers.  I have several offerings that seldom get used, but each will work to some degree.  This spool tool screws into the suction base and holds a spool of line best if it comes on a narrow spool, such as some braid comes on with about 150 yards.  The larger spools are more of a challenge, as room on the arm is limited.  The locking mechanism for the spring tension is two wing nuts that tighten onto the 1/4" aluminum shaped rod.  The springs can be tensioned for a loose or a tight squeeze onto the spool hole.  Conical wedges are nice for sliding into the different hole sizes and keeping the spool smoothly aligned for turning true.  The suction base will not hold, even on a smooth surface.  My desk top is glass and the suction cup will not hold.  The materials are light weight but should hold up, but without the base suction cup working as it should, it is not effective.  An angle bracket of aluminum, drilled for the threaded bottom to go onto and a powerful Magnet to hold onto a metal door or a ferrous solid object, like an anvil will secure this properly.  Two stars for design flaws and the poor non-suction cup base.  One star for overall fail.

text_fidelity_a:
YONEX Super GRAP 30-Pack Racket Grips In humid weather when I sweat a bit, I prefer the blue Tourna Grip overgrip or a leather grip roughed up with sandpaper. However, when it's dry and/or cold out, I find that those get a bit slippery so I go for something rubbery. I've tried similar Prince, Wilson, Babolat, and Tourna overgrips, but these Yonex Super Grap overgrips are my favorites. They're rubbery with good traction without being outright sticky. The color of the grip doesn't bleed onto the player's hand like some others do. They are reasonably durable, and over time turn kind of cloth-like where the rubbery outer layer has worn through. This is a fairly thin, non-cushioning overgrip (which I like).

A quick note on this pack: Finishing tape is included not as a roll, but as 30 pre-cut pieces bundled together with a rubber band. The finishing tape is a bit stiff, not as stretchy, and a little easier to break as others I've run across. So the finishing tape isn't the greatest, but it's perfectly serviceable. The overgrip tape itself is also pre-cut to length with an angled cut and adhesive strip on one end. The adhesive does leave some residue, but it can be cleaned off. I've not had any issues with the rest of the tape leaving any residue or being hard to remove from the grip.
text_fidelity_b: YONEX Super GRAP 30-Pack Racket Grips

text_fidelity_a:
Graphite Pickleball Paddles Set of 4, 2023 USAPA Approved, Carbon Fiber Surface (CHS), Polypropylene Lightweight Honeycomb Core, 3 Indoor 3 Outdoor Pickleball, 4 Replacement Soft Grip + Bag I like that this comes with its own little zippered carrying case. That's just an extra that makes it nicer than having to find a duffel-bag or some other place to carry the set.

It comes with 4 paddles that are the same except for the colors. It has 3 indoor and 3 outdoor balls which are almost identical except for the spacing of the holes. They're like Whiffle™ balls. The holes prevent them from going too far from the air resistance. The ones for indoors are the ones with the bigger holes because you can't hit them as far.

I know it says that you can play indoors and technically that's true, but it depends on where you're playing. A big game room with lots of space would work. A place where you can trip over furniture or knock over lamps isn't a good idea. It also depends on how aggressive you want to be with your swings. The indoor balls are not the problem because they couldn't easily build up enough momentum to break anything except very delicate or top-heavy things. But the paddles swinging around are more of the issue with playing indoors. A big swing or stretch if you aren't aware of the stuff around you could be where you'd break something or trip over something. But still, about the same level of caution you'd have with Ping-Pong, but without the table to keep you in place.

The paddles are pretty nice quality and lighter than they look like they should be. But they have a lot of surface area and the balls are easier to hit than with Ping-Pong paddles.

You'll have to look up the rules online because they aren't included, but really that's only if you want to play "official Pickle-ball". You can play it with Ping-pong rules, badminton rules, volleyball rules, tennis rules -- just about any of the similar kind of games that I can think of -- it's just a bit easier and has requires less skill or movement. It's really about the same level of activity that you'd have with badminton and the same sized area if you're playing outdoors.

Personally, indoors is just if we want to play "hit-the-ball-back-and-forth-down-the-hallway" because it's too hot/cold/wet outside.

This doesn't come with a net, and I thought the rubberband strips might have been to map out the court area, but it's supposed to be for the grip on the paddles. If you're going to play "official" you'll need a net which is pretty much the same as a badminton net just not as high. It's basically a mini tennis court with much the same net.

It's good exercise, and I can't imagine this being a competitive sport, but I was wrong about tag being an 'official' sport when I heard someone mention it -- but it actually is and surprisingly fun to watch -- with sponsors and everything. Pickleball might be the same because why wouldn't someone take something that's fun and add a bunch of rules so they can make some money from advertising.

It's good for staying active and just about everyone likes to play because we don't play with any real rules. Not because we have odd ideas like "there are no losers here", but because it's just that unimportant.

I can't comment on the price with the way things are these days, but it seems to be about the same price as other options, and the quality is decent. The bag is a bonus and even the dog likes to play -- but that's where it goes from being 'pickle-ball' to 'slobber-ball'.

Overall, this is a nice set, especially the paddles. Five stars.
text_fidelity_b: Graphite Pickleball Paddles Set of 4, 2023 USAPA Approved, Carbon Fiber Surface (CHS), Polypropylene Lightweight Honeycomb Core, 3 Indoor 3 Outdoor Pickleball, 4 Replacement Soft Grip + Bag

text_fidelity_a:
For Sport Ya Professional Sport Electronic Whistle with Lanyard, Ultra Loud Sound and Long Battery Life - Perfect for Outdoor Sports, Coaches, Referee, Gym Teachers, Lifeguard and Emergency This is the first electronic whistle I have ever seen or used and I have been impressed with it so far. I was not exactly sure what to expect from it and I was curious to see how it would compare to a traditional whistle. It definitely has some advantages over a regular whistle and is very definitely worth some consideration if you officiate outdoor sports.

This is a small and not unattractive device, about the size of a tube to toothpaste (slightly smaller) and bright yellow. It has a lanyard attached to it so it can be hund around the neck like a traditional whistle to secure to a wrist if that is preferred. One end is open and this is where the sound comes out. There’s a single button control on the side for activating the whistle, and a switch that allows for switching between two different tones and turning the whole unit off.

The whistle takes two CR2032 batteries, included in the package. This is a relatively common battery size now so it is easy to find replacement batteries when the batteries are depleted. While AAA batteries would have made more sense to me, they would have added weight to the whistle so button batteries are a good choice.

This is a LOUD whistle! It is a bit louder than I expected. Tone one is a traditional whistle sound and is suitable for officiating at outdoor games like soccer and football. The second tone is slightly lower and has more of a buzz two it; this tone would also work for outdoor sports, but I think it is best suited for when there are two officials and you want to differentiate between the two of them.

I would stop short of calling this whistle waterproof but it is definitely acceptable for use outside in light rain.

The main advantage this whistle has over a traditional whistle is the fact that it does not require any effort. You do not have to blow through it which gets tiring after a while with normal whistles. Also, because you never have to put your mouth on it, it is more sanitary.

If you have need to use a whistle, particularly outdoors, this electronic whistle is a good choice. It is cleaner that a traditional whistle, it is at least as loud, it has two distinct sounds and is semi-waterproof.

Disclosure: I was provided a sample of this product in exchange for a fair, honest and thorough review. Even though I received this product at no/minimal cost I have rated and reviewed this product without bias, based solely on my experience with it.
text_fidelity_b: For Sport Ya Professional Sport Electronic Whistle with Lanyard, Ultra Loud Sound and Long Battery Life - Perfect for Outdoor Sports, Coaches, Referee, Gym Teachers, Lifeguard and Emergency
